title: OVER/XOVER materialises full result Vec before sending
description: O(N) ALLOCATION — query_range (overview.rs:138) fetches up to MAX_OVER_RESULTS (10 000) OverviewRow structs into a Vec, maps them to OverviewRecord (another Vec), then over_response (over.rs:29) maps those to formatted Strings (a third Vec), all before a single byte hits the wire. For a 10k-article OVER response this creates ~3 large allocations. Fix: stream rows directly from the SQLite cursor into a write buffer using fetch() instead of fetch_all(), eliminating the intermediate Vec materialisation.
